perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: Western Gateway's August 11 final investment decision remains the newest material issuer project disclosure located; KMI holds 35.1% and contributes existing SFPP assets to the proposed 1,300-mile, 230,000 bpd system.
A fresh issuer-domain check found no later material project-execution release, so the retained FID is reused without manufacturing novelty.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: FID improves project certainty, while realized value still depends on permitting, construction, capital discipline, contracted throughput and incremental return economics.
Existing-asset contribution may reduce greenfield intensity but does not establish the return profile without net capital and earnings disclosure.

sources.use: project FID, ownership and design-capacity evidence
